title: Hallowing

fields.label: shop
fields.value: The Monstrous Manor (Boxed Spider and Mausoleum Key)

body:
"A powerful tool capable of controling the way of the moon"

The Hallowing is a red glowing staff with a spider and bat wings on it. It can be obtained by fusing a Broken Fence, a Plastic Spider (Unboxed) and a Catseye Ore (Raw ore) in unknown structure below The Monstrous Manor during a blood moon.

It is can be used to summon The Blood Moon at nights (18:00-5:00). After each use, it has a reload time 1 hour.

Trivia

In the description Controlling is misspelt as "Controling"
